notes: Claim ids c01-c48 follow document order: sections (c01-c25), faqs (c26-c41), keyFacts (c42-c48). Edits made in drafts/salbutamol.article.json: removed SmPC pregnancy caution and emc reference; interactions reworded to the NHS list (diuretics, steroid tablets, theophylline/aminophylline, beta blockers; herbal remedies); side-effect routing now only what was retrieved (111 for pounding heartbeat after overuse, 999 for chest pain/breathlessness/anaphylaxis); 'twice a week' and 'puffs' counts dropped; faq about 'addictive' retitled. Doubt: warning signs such as muscle weakness/cramps/irregular heartbeat/very bad dizziness now have no explicit route to care because the NHS contact route was not retrieved. Doubt: 5 textbook sentences (about 1 in 10, above the 1 in 20 guide). Asthma and Lung UK snippet was used for 'worse at any point' and same-day GP/nurse appointment. Search summaries blend pages so URL attribution within the NHS salbutamol set is page-level approximate. medications.json entry not contradicted (it uses the word 'safe' itself; the article does not).
